topic_label: Commitment to integrity and ethical values
control_description: Group code of conduct and security acknowledgments; sanctions procedure
Board risk committee oversees cyber and product security risk quarterly
Group CISO, Chief Product Security Officer, and DCC security official with defined reporting lines (POL-01)
Background checks; annual and role-based training for DCC engineers
Accountability through POL-01 roles and sanctions
Asset, data, and SBOM inventories from cloud tooling and the release pipeline

topic_label: Internal communication of objectives and responsibilities
control_description: Policies published and acknowledged annually; DCC runbooks in the wiki
Service commitments in hospital contracts and BAAs; customer security guide; complementary user entity controls in the system description
gap: The system description's complementary user entity controls do not say that hospital administrators who publish drug libraries must use MFA or federation (MD-028)
remediation: Add the control to the system description and the customer security guide; notify hospitals

topic_label: Objectives specified to enable risk identification
control_description: Objectives and risk tolerance in POL-01 and P01
Annual SP 800-30 risk analysis in the Medical Devices register
Insider misuse and fraud considered in the risk analysis (support access, drug library changes)
Significant changes (new products, new subprocessors, acquisitions) assessed through change control and the SPDF
Group internal audit assesses common controls yearly and sampled DCC controls in 2026
Deficiencies tracked in the group POA&M and reported to the board risk committee

topic_label: Control activities selected to mitigate risk
control_description: Controls selected from the SP 800-53 baseline and the common control catalog
General IT controls through SYS-G1 to SYS-G3

topic_label: Control activities deployed through policies and procedures
control_description: Group policies and the Medical Devices supplement

topic_label: Logical access security software, infrastructure, architecture
control_description: SSO, MFA, PAM, and encryption with customer-managed keys
Identity governance from HR events; hospital users provisioned by hospital administrators
Role-based access; support access reviewed monthly
gap: Support and site reliability staff hold standing read access to all tenants' PHI (MD-008)
remediation: Just-in-time support access linked to tickets

control_description: Physical security inherited from cloud providers (carved out)
Provider media sanitization; logical deletion procedures

topic_label: Protection against threats from outside boundaries
control_description: Hub firewalls, WAF, DDoS protection, mutual TLS for devices

topic_label: Restriction of data transmission and movement
control_description: TLS for all transmission; EHR interfaces over private connections

topic_label: Prevention and detection of unauthorized or malicious software
control_description: EDR and image scanning; signed images only

topic_label: Detection of configuration changes and vulnerabilities
control_description: Weekly vulnerability scans; SBOM matching against the KEV catalog; guardrail drift reports

topic_label: Monitoring for anomalies and security events
control_description: 24x7 SOC monitoring of DCC logs; PSIRT monitoring of device telemetry anomalies
Triage and severity rating by the SOC and PSIRT
Group IR plan, PSIRT procedure, and business associate breach procedure
gap: The PSIRT procedure has no step to decide whether a device incident is also a breach of PHI in the DCC, and the BAA terms register covers 81% of BAAs (POAM-023)
remediation: Add the 164.402 step; complete the register; include in the 2026-12-15 tabletop

control_description: Recovery from immutable backups; warm standby in provider B; lessons learned
Change authorization, testing, security review, and staged rollout
Continuity plans and cyber insurance

topic_label: Vendor and business partner risk management
control_description: Tiered vendor program; subcontractor BAAs and SOC report reviews for the cloud providers, ticketing, and log analytics vendors
Capacity monitoring and autoscaling for ingestion and APIs
Multi-zone deployment; point-in-time recovery; immutable backups in provider B
Semiannual failover and restore tests

topic_label: Identification and maintenance of confidential information
control_description: Confidential information (PHI, device data) identified by classification and tenant tags (POL-04)
Return or destruction of hospital data at contract end with certificates
gap: 3 of 11 hospitals offboarded in 2026 have no destruction certificate; deletion is partly manual
remediation: Automated tenant deletion with certificate generation
